create_SyntheticDatasetConfig: create a SyntheticDatasetConfig to configure synthetic meeting generation parameters like sample rate and augmentation
build_SyntheticDataset: build a SyntheticDataset from a config to generate synthetic speaker diarization meetings from an ASR dataset
run_generate: run the generate method to produce a Hugging Face dataset of synthetic multi-speaker meeting audio with diarization annotations
test_concatenate: test the concatenate method to merge sampled audio segments into a single meeting audio file with speaker timestamps
review_create_meeting: review the create_meeting method that concatenates audio segments with configurable overlap and silence insertion
